objections: Cost versus hiring an outbound employee
Whether the service fits the client's offer
contradictions: promise-drift — Clarify whether one is a target, average or rounded slogan. — 20+ leads per month and 1 lead per day both appear. — Those expressions are not mathematically identical.
timing-drift — The first-lead timing needs version control. — The homepage referenced 36 hours. — The reviewed service page referenced 48 hours.
pricing-drift — Use the live range with its verification date. — A prior dataset value simplified the service to USD 3,000. — The current reviewed page showed USD 2,000–3,000.
inferences: Founder authority is being used as a trust substitute for a shorter enterprise-style buying process. — confidence: high — basis: The funnel devotes substantial copy to the founder's method and point of view.
The 15-minute call is likely a qualification gate before a private proposal. — confidence: medium — basis: Pricing is a range and the public journey stops at booking or contact.
notObservable: Scheduler questions after selecting a slot
limitations: No form or calendar action was completed.
Performance claims and testimonials were not independently audited.
Dynamic or personalized follow-up was outside the public observation boundary.

copy: A clear founder point of view
A tangible mechanism instead of generic lead-generation language
avoid: Conflicting monthly and daily lead promises
test: Founder-led long-form page versus concise diagnostic page
Money-back language with one precisely defined success metric
